@[simp] theorem lookup_nil (i : ClientId) : lookup [] i = none := rfl

theorem lookup_cons (c : Client) (cs : List Client) (i : ClientId) :
    lookup (c :: cs) i = if c.id = i then some c else lookup cs i := rfl
